column1: # SEC-08 (#4246) unsafe_code allowlist. Format: <crate dir relative to repo root><TAB><reason>.
# Every workspace member NOT listed here must inherit `[workspace.lints.rust] unsafe_code = "forbid"`;
# a listed one must carry `unsafe_code = "allow"` in its own Cargo.toml. scripts/check_unsafe_policy.py enforces both.
# Reason = why unsafe is needed and why a safe replacement does not exist. clients/desktop is its own cargo
# workspace (cannot inherit server-rust lints); it is listed so the exception is recorded in one place.

column2: Linux syscalls (prctl/setrlimit/fcntl/poll/socketpair/pipe/ioctl, OwnedFd::from_raw_fd, pre_exec capability clearing) that form the in-box sandbox boundary; std has no safe equivalent
host process control and peer credentials (geteuid/getpeereid/kill/killpg/getpgid/proc_listchildpids, O_NOFOLLOW, Security.framework reads, volatile zeroing); std has no safe equivalent
libloading::Library::new/get to load the ONNX Runtime shared library; loading a native library is unsafe by definition
single libc::geteuid() root check; std has no safe euid API, replacing it needs a new dependency (follow-up candidate)
single libc::geteuid() root check for the PITR runbook; same as momo-box-runner (follow-up candidate)
Secure Enclave/Security.framework FFI (device_key/enclave.rs) and PTY/process libc calls; separate cargo workspace, outside the server-rust lint
